findings.evidence: Examples column restates obvious instances of each category: Instant search, predictive loading; Auto-scheduling, smart defaults; Recommendations, anomaly detection; Sharing, comments, real-time editing; Dashboards, progress tracking; Animations, celebrations, polish
findings.fix: Keep the ten category questions (the coverage check the Discover step depends on). Replace the example cell with a non-obvious mechanism the model would not invent, or drop only that cell and record the removal in docs/audit/recovery/game-changing-features/record.md; do not delete the category table.

findings.evidence: NEVER list has four specific rules with reasons, but the environment-specific landmines (flag files are not production, telemetry renames, registered vs active, stale roadmaps, conflicting sources) live in Gotchas with no NEVER-grade failure mode for mis-citing them
findings.fix: Add one NEVER that cites the Gotchas: NEVER call a capability live, unused, or a new build from a flag file, a zero telemetry count, a registered-account total or a roadmap line without the environment, tracking-plan, active-user or changelog check that Gotchas names, because each of those sources systematically lies.

findings.evidence: Step 4.3 says every idea other than Do Now is Do Next, Explore or Backlog, each with its reason, but never defines how to choose among those three labels
findings.fix: Give one default: Do Next is the next idea whose cheapest test fits capacity after Do Now; Explore is a higher tier whose test does not fit or whose evidence is 1; Backlog is everything else. Keep the reason cell so a close call can override the default.

findings.evidence: casual-strategy, precise-roadmap, feature-request and category-coverage assert no implementation code and hypothesis labels, but none checks the ranking formula (reach share times evidence divided by effort plus adoption cost), the hypothesis: prefix, citation resolution, or that Do Now is the highest-scoring idea whose test fits capacity
findings.fix: Add assertions the output can be checked against: one idea only is Do Now and it is the highest-scoring idea whose cheapest test fits the stated team; every number not taken from the prompt is prefixed hypothesis:; the feature-request eval's comparison table has exactly the columns Idea, Priority, Mechanism and impact, Reach, Effort, Next test.

findings.evidence: The full-session template ends after Validation questions, while the single-feature branch (lines 42-42) requires Scope, Baseline, a different comparison table and Validation questions, and step 4.3's No Do Now yet outcome has no row in either template
findings.fix: Add the single-feature table (Idea, Priority, Mechanism and impact, Reach, Effort, Next test) as a second fenced template, and one template line for the No Do Now yet case: the missing capacity constraint and the cheapest question or test that resolves it.

findings.evidence: Baseline says list the folders under .claude/docs/ai/ and reuse the one whose prior session names the same product, but does not say what to do when two folders both match or when the directory cannot be listed
findings.fix: State the branch: if listing fails, use the kebab-case product slug and say the prior-session search was skipped; if two folders match, reuse the one with the newest session and name the other as not reused.
